criteria.blocker: Four of the six named clauses fail at head, unchanged by the remediation commits. The strongest is that two of them -- incremental sync and bounce/retry/DLQ -- have no implementation whatsoever: mail sync checkpoints are write-only with zero readers, and src/modules/mail/ contains no DLQ, bounce, retry, backoff, cron, queue or consumer of any kind.
criteria.clauses_failing: indexed search (zero-match path discards the index answer and falls back to an unindexed scan); indexed unread (no unread query and no is_read index -- a JS filter over a bounded provider fanout); incremental sync (checkpoints written, never read); bounce/retry/DLQ (absent entirely). Clauses 'indexed conversation ordering', 'idempotent send' and 'invalidation of list/thread/count keys' hold.
criteria.evidence:
indexed search FAILS: /Users/tarunchintakunta/Personal/streamline/streamlineos-backend/src/modules/mail/mail-metadata.service.ts:165 `if (rows.length === 0 || rows.length > SEARCH_ID_CAP) return literal;` -- when app.search_mail_message_ids answers 'nothing matches', that answer is DISCARDED and `literal` (the ILIKE fallback, `sql\`true\`` when there is none, :159) is returned instead, so the no-match query is re-derived by an unindexed scan. Corroborating: mail-metadata-keyset-search.spec.ts has no case for the zero-row path (grep for 'rows.length === 0|zero|no match|empty result' in that spec returns nothing), so the branch is green because it is untested.

indexed unread FAILS: /Users/tarunchintakunta/Personal/streamline/streamlineos-backend/src/modules/notifications/unified-inbox.service.ts:385-403 `countMailUnread` calls `this.mail.listMessages(orgId, userId, membershipId, 'inbox', 'all', MAIL_COUNT_SCAN_LIMIT, undefined)` and then `unread: result.messages.filter((m) => !m.isRead).length` -- there is no unread SQL predicate at all, the count is capped and self-reports `exact: result.messages.length < MAIL_COUNT_SCAN_LIMIT`, and no is_read index exists.

incremental sync FAILS: `grep -rn 'loadPosition|clearPositions' src --include='*.ts' | grep -v spec.ts` returns ONLY the two definitions, /Users/tarunchintakunta/Personal/streamline/streamlineos-backend/src/modules/mail/mail-sync-checkpoint.service.ts:13 and :51. Zero production callers. mail_sync_checkpoints is written and never read, so every sync is a full pull.

bounce/retry/DLQ FAILS: `grep -rniE 'dlq|deadletter|dead_letter|bounce|backoff' src/modules/mail/` -> exit 1 (no matches). `grep -rniE '@Cron|Queue|Processor|@OnEvent' src/modules/mail/ --include='*.ts'` -> exit 1. There is no worker, no queue and no retry policy on the mail path.

CLAUSES HOLDING: ordering -- mail-metadata.service.ts:244 `.orderBy(desc(date), desc(id)).limit(limit+1)` against idx_mail_metadata_list_keyset declared at src/db/schema/.../mail-metadata.ts:40-46. Idempotent send -- mail.controller.ts:112 @Idempotent("mail.send") and :128 @Idempotent("mail.reply"); there is no receive path, so 'idempotent receive' is N/A rather than met. Invalidation -- frontend hooks/api/mail.ts:100-101,115-116,188-189 plus server mail.service.ts:450.

NOT MEASURED: the performance magnitude of the search and unread defects. The prior audit's 2.2ms->184ms numbers came from a 200k-row synthetic schema that has since been dropped; rebuilding it needs a live DB with rows. The code defects above are statically verified and do not depend on those numbers -- only the size of the penalty does.

criteria.blocker: 'compose/send states' fails on a reply form field that is rendered, validated as required, and then silently discarded; '/mail' has no offline branch outside the compose sheet; and 'account-revocation E2E' is INCONCLUSIVE for an absent prerequisite (no e2e tier exists in the frontend and no backend e2e spec touches a /mail route) -- which under the exit-code contract is never a pass.
criteria.clauses_failing: compose/send states; offline/reconnect (the /mail list pane half); account-revocation E2E (INCONCLUSIVE, prerequisite absent); infinite lists (three cursor defects). Clauses 'thread hydration', 'optimistic read/label rollback' and 'sanitization' hold.
criteria.evidence:
compose/send states FAILS: /Users/tarunchintakunta/Personal/streamline/streamlineos-frontend/frontend/features/mail/mail-compose-schema.ts:18 declares `to: z.array(emailString).min(1, "At least one recipient is required")` on `mailReplySchema`, and features/mail/mail-compose-header-fields.tsx:120-131 renders it as an editable EmailChipsInput bound to `replyForm.control` name="to". But features/mail/mail-compose-sheet.tsx:243-249 sends only `{ accountId, messageId, threadId, bodyHtml, cc }` -- no `to`. offline/reconnect FAILS for /mail: `grep -rn 'useOnlineStatus|isOnline|navigator.onLine' features/mail/` returns hits ONLY in mail-compose-sheet.tsx (:19 import, :89 hook, :212 and :237 guards). mail-list-pane.tsx has none. Related and true at head: revoking a mailbox purges nothing from the mirror -- `grep -rn 'mailMessageMetadata|mail_message_metadata' src/modules/integrations/` -> exit 1, and mail-metadata.service.ts:335 markStaleForAccount has zero callers.

infinite lists FAILS (three cursor defects): unified-inbox.service.ts:153-159 resumes mail from the batch-end cursor (`m: lastMail ? (mailResult.nextMailCursor ?? cursorState.m) : cursorState.m`) while the notification/build/approval streams resume from the last RENDERED item, so trimmed mail rows are skipped; mail.service.ts:123-126 pushes a failed account onto accountErrors without adding it to accountFetches, so its cursor entry vanishes and the next page restarts that account at zero; providers/outlook-mail.provider.ts:120 computes `nextSkip` off `messages.length` (post-normalisation) where the sibling at :179 correctly uses raw `items.length`, so a filtered page ends pagination early.
